verdict.rationale: Salv's transaction-monitoring page says compliance teams can start from a scenario library and adjust each scenario's type, threshold and segments, or add their own (salv-docs-23). Supporting controls include per-scenario real-time vs. batch mode (salv-docs-25), alert suppression intervals (salv-docs-24) and backtesting scenario versions against up to a year of history (salv-docs-26). missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of rule-building and segment definition (evidence is product-page level), independent or hands-on corroboration.
